strantes, qui dicunt supremum & nulli juratum

l.i: Dominum ac legislatorem non ponere sibi-ipsi legem,
sed semper jus sibi suum integrum reservare extra or-

main_text.l: dinem agendi (prout libet. Sed quæro an Deus
jus habeat faciendi contra justitiam & decen-
tiam suam in quibusdam, in aliis vero non.
Certe tum reservavit sibi Deus jus peccandi, &
injuste agendi, unde sequitur necessario ju-
stitiam & decentiam Dei nullo modo esse re-
gulam, quam Deus sequitur in voluntatis an-
tecedentis impletione, sed Deum hic regulari à
sola sua libertate absoluta, quam quoniam
non exsequitur, invictè stat Deum infir-
mum esse, qui desideria expleta dare non
possit.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment: it reads as "gi" but is most likely "si" (long s), so it is marked [?]. The page number "332" is partly unclear at the top right. The printed "6. 2." at the foot is taken as a section number, not a catchword. The text has long s throughout and is transcribed as plain s; the printed hyphens at line ends ("sub-", "Remon-", "sibi-ipsi") are kept.
